subject: maths
question: A policeman is chasing a thief at a speed of 82 km/h. The thief is 1300 m away and is running at a speed of 64 km/h. In how much time will the policeman catch the thief if both are riding on bikes?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Since both the policeman and the thief are moving in the same direction, relative speed = 82 − 64 = 18 km/h.

Convert relative speed to m/s = 18 × (5/18) = 5 m/s.

Time required to cover 1300 m gap = Distance ÷ Relative speed = 1300 ÷ 5 = 260 sec.

**∴ The correct answer is 260 sec.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/459e8a3558179988894b40dc8d137de344ddb061ab6ac577bf8c6f0cd38428ab.png] 

**Given:**

Speed of Policeman (S₁) = 82 km/h

Speed of Thief (S₂) = 64 km/h

Initial distance between them (D) = 1300 m

**Formula Used:**

Relative Speed (when moving in the same direction) = S₁ − S₂

Time = Distance ÷ Relative Speed

1 km/h = 5/18 m/s

**Calculations:**

⇒ Relative Speed = 82 − 64 = 18 km/h

⇒ Convert speed into m/s: 18 × (5/18) = 5 m/s

⇒ Time taken to catch the thief = Distance ÷ Relative Speed

⇒ Time taken = 1300 ÷ 5 = 260 seconds

**∴ The correct answer is 260 sec.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Relative Speed

When two bodies are moving in the same direction, their relative speed is the difference of their individual speeds: SR = S₁ − S₂. When moving in opposite directions, it is the sum of their individual speeds: SR = S₁ + S₂.

Speed Unit Conversion

To convert speed from km/h to m/s, multiply the value by 5/18. To convert speed from m/s to km/h, multiply the value by 18/5.

Average Speed

Average speed is the Total Distance Covered divided by Total Time Taken. If a person covers two equal distances at speeds x and y, Average Speed = (2 × x × y) ÷ (x + y).
